description: This PHP script interacts with the TestLink API via XML-RPC to create test projects, test plans, builds, and platforms. It defines functions for each creation process and executes them with specific parameters.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Standard PHP class used for configuration and platform objects.

methods.name: createTestProject
methods.description: Creates a new test project via XML-RPC API.

methods.name: createTestPlan
methods.description: Creates a new test plan associated with a test project.

methods.name: createBuild
methods.description: Creates a new build linked to a test plan.

methods.name: createPlatform
methods.description: Creates multiple platform entries for a test project.
